Running example: two loads and one comparison示例：两次读取与一次比较

“Load dataset A and dataset B, then compare their statistics.”

“分别读取数据集 A 和数据集 B，然后比较二者的统计结果。”

a=load⁡(A),b=load⁡(B),c=compare⁡(out⁡(a),out⁡(b))a=\operatorname{load}(\mathrm{A}),\qquad b=\operatorname{load}(\mathrm{B}),\qquad c=\operatorname{compare}\big(\operatorname{out}(a),\operatorname{out}(b)\big)a=load(A),b=load(B),c=compare(out(a),out(b))
a≺c,b≺ca\prec c,\qquad b\prec ca≺c,b≺c

With fixed data snapshots and non-interfering loads, the only required orderings are aaa before ccc and bbb before ccc.

在数据快照固定、两次读取互不干扰的条件下，唯一必须满足的顺序是 aaa 先于 ccc、bbb 先于 ccc。

Nothing requires aaa to precede bbb, so (a,b,c)(a,b,c)(a,b,c) and (b,a,c)(b,a,c)(b,a,c) are two executions of the same dependency-structured computation.

任务并不要求 aaa 先于 bbb，因此 (a,b,c)(a,b,c)(a,b,c) 与 (b,a,c)(b,a,c)(b,a,c) 是同一个依赖结构计算的两种执行。

Task semantics and serialization choice任务语义与序列化选择

LSFT=−log⁡Pθ(a,b,c∣x)\LSFT=-\log P_\theta(a,b,c\mid x)LSFT​=−logPθ​(a,b,c∣x)
  • Task semantics. They specify which actions and data dependencies are necessary, for example both loads must finish before the comparison runs.
  • 任务语义：规定哪些动作和数据依赖是必要的，例如两次读取都必须在比较之前完成。
  • Serialization choice. It records which independent action the demonstrator happened to write first, here the load of A before the load of B.
  • 序列化选择：记录示范者恰好先写下了哪个独立动作，这里是先读取 A、再读取 B。

The SFT target encodes both as the same relation, one span preceding another, so the loss cannot separate them.

SFT 目标把两者编码成同一种关系，即一段内容出现在另一段之前，因此损失函数无法将二者区分开。

来自 v2 草稿。对工具智能体而言，问题在于监督信号可能施加了任务本身并不需要的约束。

Consequences for tool-using agents对工具智能体的影响

Data and compute数据与算力

One computation can admit many valid orders, so teaching each order as a separate example spends data and compute repeatedly on one computation.

同一计算可能有许多合法顺序；若把每种顺序都当作单独样本来教，数据和算力就会被重复花在同一个计算上。

Resuming partial work接续部分完成的工作

An agent may need to continue work that another executor partly completed, and one memorized order from scratch does not guarantee this ability.

智能体可能需要接续其他执行者已部分完成的工作，而从头记住一种顺序并不能保证具备这种能力。

Argument availability参数可用性

An agent must know which arguments are already available, which prerequisites are unmet, and which call produced each value.

智能体需要知道哪些参数已经可用、哪些前提尚未满足，以及每个值由哪次调用产生。

From the v2 draft.The draft concludes that execution progress and argument provenance should become explicit objects of post-training.

来自 v2 草稿。草稿据此认为，执行进度与参数来源应当成为后训练中的显式对象。

Learning a correct call order is different from learning to manage execution state across several dependent tools.

学会正确的调用顺序，并不等于学会在多个相互依赖的工具之间管理执行状态。

Evidence from FuncBenchGenFuncBenchGen 中的证据

FuncBenchGen builds tasks on a hidden function-dependency DAG, and the model must call functions until it can report a target value.

FuncBenchGen 在隐藏的函数依赖 DAG 上构造任务，模型需要不断调用函数，直到能够给出目标变量的值。

Most models write syntactically valid calls, yet they lose track of which values exist and which value belongs to which argument.

多数模型能写出语法正确的调用，却难以跟踪哪些值已经存在，以及哪个值应当填入哪个参数。

Restating all known variable values after every call raised the success rate of GPT-5 from 62.5% to 81.3%, according to the paper.

论文报告，在每次调用后重述所有已知变量值，可使 GPT-5 的成功率从 62.5% 提升到 81.3%。

Two failure types in the running example示例中的两类错误

Value Not Yet KnownValue Not Yet Known（值尚未获得）

Completed已完成A → flight_price = 1200Missing缺失B → hotel_price
calculate_total(flight_price=1200, hotel_price=?) ✗

The agent called A but not B and already tries C, so it never checked the preconditions of C.

智能体调用了 A 却还没有调用 B，就已尝试执行 C，说明它没有检查 C 的前置条件。

Incorrect ValueIncorrect Value（值错误）

Completed已完成A → 1200, B → 600Passed传入hotel_price = 900
calculate_total(flight_price=1200, hotel_price=900) ✗

The correct value 600 is already available, but the agent passes 900, possibly a value returned by another tool.

正确的值 600 已经可用，智能体却传入了 900，这个值可能来自环境中另一个工具的返回结果。

In both cases the link between a variable, the call that produced it, and its actual value has been lost.

两种情况下，变量、产生它的调用与其实际取值之间的对应关系都已经丢失。

Both errors concern execution state: which call is executable now, and which real arguments it should receive.

两类错误都与执行状态有关：现在可以执行哪个调用，以及它应当接收哪些真实参数。

Central research hypothesis核心研究假设

Hypothesis.An agent can learn the whole set of semantically valid tool-call orders and complete the remaining work from any valid intermediate state.

假设。智能体可以学会全部语义合法的工具调用顺序，并能从任意合法的中间状态完成剩余工作。

The earlier draft states a testable version for tasks whose ordering freedom is large and can be identified reliably.

较早的草稿针对顺序自由度足够大、且可以被可靠识别的任务，给出了可检验的表述。

Hypothesis.Under these conditions, training on the set of valid executions gives a better capability–compute trade-off than fixed-order supervision, order augmentation, or frontier supervision.

假设。在这些条件下，基于合法执行集合的训练，比固定顺序监督、顺序增强或前沿集合监督具有更好的能力与计算成本权衡。

Neither draft reports training results, and the only numerical evidence is a self-check that the probability recursion and gradients are implemented consistently.

两版草稿都没有报告训练结果；仅有的数值证据是一项自检，用来确认概率递推与梯度的实现彼此一致。

Limits of order augmentation顺序增强的局限

The direct fix samples more valid reorderings from the dependency graph and trains on each one as a separate sequence.

直接的做法是从依赖图中采样更多合法重排，并把每一种重排都作为单独的序列来训练。

  • Sampling distribution. Augmentation must choose a distribution over orders, and the model is then also trained to match that distribution.
  • 采样分布：增强必须指定一个顺序分布，于是模型还要被训练去拟合这个分布。
  • Repeated scoring. Trajectories that reach the same state after independent actions are still scored as separate sequences from start to end.
  • 重复计分：经过一组独立动作后到达同一状态的轨迹，仍被当作不同序列从头到尾分别计分。
  • No resumption guarantee. A model that reliably completes A→B→CA\to B\to CA→B→C may still fail when another agent has already completed BBB.
  • 无法保证接续：一个能稳定完成 A→B→CA\to B\to CA→B→C 的模型，在 BBB 已由另一个智能体完成时仍可能失败。

C(G)={(aA,aB,aC,aend⋆),  (aB,aA,aC,aend⋆)}\mathcal{C}(G)=\big\{(a_A,a_B,a_C,\aend),\ \ (a_B,a_A,a_C,\aend)\big\}C(G)={(aA​,aB​,aC​,aend⋆​),  (aB​,aA​,aC​,aend⋆​)}
  • A linear extension of GGG orders all nodes so that each edge starts at an earlier node; LinExt⁡(G)\LinExt(G)LinExt(G) collects all of them.
  • GGG 的线性扩展是全部节点的一种排列，其中每条边的起点都排在终点之前；LinExt⁡(G)\LinExt(G)LinExt(G) 是所有这类排列的集合。
  • The accepted execution set C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G) writes each linear extension as full tool calls and appends the terminal action.
  • 接受执行集合 C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G) 把每个线性扩展写成完整的工具调用序列，并在末尾加上终止动作。
  • Any generated sequence inside C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G) counts as a correct execution, even when it differs from the demonstration.
  • 模型生成的序列只要属于 C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G)，就算作正确执行，即使它与示范轨迹不同。
  • Uncertain pairs keep their demonstrated order, so C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G) can be smaller than the set of all truly equivalent executions.
  • 不确定的动作对会保留示范顺序，因此 C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G) 可能小于全部真正等价的执行集合。

  • Reduce maps every history with the same task progress to one canonical state built from completed actions and their observations.
  • Reduce 把任务进度相同的所有历史映射为同一个规范化状态，该状态只由已完成动作及其观察构成。

  • Reduce may use only past actions, actual observations, and runtime contracts, never the target graph or future actions.
  • Reduce 只能使用已发生的动作、实际观察和运行时可访问的契约，不能使用目标图或未来动作。

Condition for sharing a state状态共享的条件

HI=State⁡(x,I)H_I=\State(x,I)HI​=State(x,I)

Merging is exact only when every accepted route to III yields the same canonical state, and therefore the same model input.

只有当所有到达 III 的接受路径都产生相同的规范化状态，从而产生相同的模型输入时，合并才是精确的。

  • Deterministic accepted paths. Tool results on accepted paths are deterministic, or they have a verified equivalent canonical form.
  • 接受路径确定：接受路径上的工具结果是确定的，或者具有经过验证的等价规范形式。
  • Order-invariant reduction. Swapping two certified independent actions leaves the reduced state unchanged, written as Reduce⁡(h a oa b ob)=Reduce⁡(h b ob a oa)\Reduce(h\,a\,o_a\,b\,o_b)=\Reduce(h\,b\,o_b\,a\,o_a)Reduce(haoa​bob​)=Reduce(hbob​aoa​).
  • 归约与顺序无关：交换两个经认证独立的动作不会改变归约后的状态，记为 Reduce⁡(h a oa b ob)=Reduce⁡(h b ob a oa)\Reduce(h\,a\,o_a\,b\,o_b)=\Reduce(h\,b\,o_b\,a\,o_a)Reduce(haoa​bob​)=Reduce(hbob​aoa​)。
  • No hidden memory. The policy carries no scratchpad across turns, so the same HIH_IHI​ always produces the same model input.
  • 无隐藏记忆：策略在回合之间不保留额外的草稿文本，因此相同的 HIH_IHI​ 总是产生相同的模型输入。

Note.Sharing saves computation only, since different routes to III keep their own probabilities, which are summed rather than assumed equal.

说明。共享只是节省计算：到达 III 的不同路径各自保留自己的概率，这些概率被相加，而不是被假设为相等。

  • Ordered prefixes count the nodes of a prefix tree, so prefix caching alone cannot merge AAA then BBB with BBB then AAA (my synthesis).

  • The state count can still grow exponentially, and the saving exists only when mergeable states actually occur, as v2 notes.

Assumptions and scope假设与适用范围

  • Deterministic accepted paths. Accepted actions return fixed results under the snapshot, while invalid inputs may still produce random errors, as in FuncBenchGen.
  • 接受路径确定：在快照下，接受动作返回确定的结果；无效输入仍可能产生随机错误，FuncBenchGen 即是如此。
  • Finite demonstrations. Loops are unrolled to the number of iterations actually observed, and the graph does not cover other iteration counts.
  • 有限示范：循环按实际发生的次数展开，目标图不覆盖其他循环次数。
  • Conservative graphs. A wrong independence claim adds illegal executions to positive supervision, which the earlier draft names the highest-priority risk.
  • 保守构图：错误的独立性判断会把非法执行加入正向监督，较早的草稿把它列为最高优先级的风险。
  • Successful prefixes only. The objective covers legal partial executions and does not teach recovery after tool failures or wrong writes.
  • 只含成功前缀：该目标只覆盖合法的部分执行，不学习工具失败或错误写入之后的恢复。
  • One accepted set per task. Solutions that use other tools or algorithms lie outside C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G), so evaluation must use environment success.
  • 每个任务一个接受集合：使用其他工具或算法的解不属于 C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G)，因此评估必须以环境中的任务成功为准。

Metrics and falsification criteria评价指标与证伪标准

Planned testbeds are FuncBenchGen extended with effect contracts and restorable snapshots, and an instrumented subset of AppWorld tasks.

计划的测试环境包括：加入作用契约与可恢复快照的扩展版 FuncBenchGen，以及经过插桩的 AppWorld 任务子集。

Metrics评价指标

  • Task success rate in the real environment, judged by a programmatic state check.
  • 真实环境中的任务成功率，由程序化的状态检查判定。
  • Resume success from valid prefixes, with the backend restored to the matching state.
  • 从合法前缀接续的成功率，后端需恢复到对应状态。
  • Auxiliary errors: argument provenance, unknown-variable use, redundant calls, early termination, and side effects.
  • 辅助错误：参数来源、使用未知变量、冗余调用、提前终止与副作用。
  • Full cost: training tokens, GPU time, scoring calls, environment calls, and graph construction.
  • 完整成本：训练 token 数、GPU 时间、计分次数、环境调用与构图开销。

Falsification criteria证伪标准

  • Simple methods suffice: a canonical order or order augmentation matches the method at equal budget.
  • 简单方法已足够：在相同预算下，规范顺序或顺序增强达到同等表现。
  • Local supervision suffices: frontier supervision reaches the same result at much lower cost.
  • 局部监督已足够：前沿集合监督以低得多的成本达到同等效果。
  • Too little structure: most real task graphs reduce to chains, or certification costs too much.
  • 可用结构太少：大多数真实任务图退化为链，或认证成本过高。
  • Representation dominates: gains come almost entirely from the variable table or canonical state.
  • 表示占主导：收益几乎全部来自变量表或规范化状态。
  • Decoding gap: likelihood gains do not turn into success under the deployed decoding strategy.
  • 解码落差：似然的改善不能转化为实际部署解码策略下的成功。

Open questions待解决的问题

  • Certification at scale. Reliable read and write contracts for real tools are hard to obtain, and their coverage limits which tasks can enter training.
  • 大规模认证：真实工具可靠的读写契约难以获得，其覆盖范围决定了哪些任务能进入训练。
  • Choice of μcut\mu_{\mathrm{cut}}μcut​. v2 leaves the cut distribution unspecified, while the earlier draft samples a depth and then ready nodes up to it.
  • μcut\mu_{\mathrm{cut}}μcut​ 的选择：v2 没有规定截断分布，较早的草稿则先采样截断深度，再逐步采样就绪节点直到该深度。
  • Posterior concentration. If the model starts with one preferred order, the success posterior concentrates on it, and prefix coverage only partly counters this.
  • 后验集中：若模型初始时偏好某一种顺序，成功后验就会集中到这一顺序上，前缀覆盖只能部分缓解这一问题。
  • Cost of canonical states. Rendered states need not share a text prefix, so reusing the key–value cache across states is not free.
  • 规范化状态的成本：渲染后的状态文本未必共享前缀，因此跨状态复用键值缓存并非没有代价。
  • Stochastic tools and several strategies. Random tool outputs and multiple solution graphs need explicit outcome branches or unions of accepted sets.
  • 随机工具与多种策略：随机的工具输出与多种解法需要显式建模结果分支，或者对多个接受集合取并集。

Summary总结

Summary总结

  • Sequence targets mix necessary dependencies with arbitrary order, so the proposed target is the set of accepted executions C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G).
  • 序列目标把必要依赖与偶然顺序混在一起，因此所提方法的训练目标是接受执行集合 C(G)\mathcal{C}(G)C(G)。
  • A canonical execution state turns equivalent histories into identical model inputs, which makes probability sharing across histories exact.
  • 规范化执行状态让等价历史成为完全相同的模型输入，从而使跨历史的概率共享成为精确计算。
  • Dynamic programming over completed sets computes the marginal likelihood, and its gradient weights each path by its success posterior.
  • 在已完成集合上的动态规划给出边际似然，其梯度按成功后验对每条路径加权。
  • Training from valid intermediate states targets resumption, a failure mode that root-only training cannot observe.
  • 从合法中间状态开始训练针对的是接续能力，而仅从根状态训练无法观察到这类失败。

Hypothesis.Whether these changes improve agents at a fixed budget is still untested, and the answer depends on reliable certification of independence.

假设。这些改变能否在固定预算下提升智能体仍未经检验，其结论取决于能否可靠地认证动作之间的独立性。
